notes.title: Update 41 - Very Tanky
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

Today the Daily Draft event ended, and we hope you all enjoyed the free tickets for special game mode.
If you didn’t get to check out the King Puff Cup’s 8th installment Sunday, make sure to watch it on their youtube channel!

Update 41 is the introduction of a crowd favorite from the Best of Brawny. While Ratbo did not win the tournament and secure a Legendary spot for his champion card, through some surprisingly “clever” political “maneuvering” and grassroots movements (we’ve heard Eeeek the Sneak was involved under a different name), he has convinced the powers that be to bring the Scrat Tank to Minion Masters as a Rare Minion.


NEW card - Scrat Tank

This very hardy vehicle used to be a junk plow, but the Scrats repurposed it for combat by giving the operator a chainsaw polearm. When no enemies are within close proximity, the lid closes to make it completely immune to damage - and falling junk.


Balance

Demon Warrior 
	
Growth rescaled to: 170 health and 40 damage per level
Starting stats rescaled to: 170 health and 40 damage.
Attack speed from 1.5 to 2.5 sec
Mana cost down from 7 to 6
Maximum level set to 10.

--- Developer comments ---
The Demon Warrior requires a fairly specific counter. You need to capitalize on the mana advantage your enemy is giving you and deal damage to him so you can finish the game before it becomes too powerful to handle. For newer players, this counter isn’t very clear, and they end up losing to a minion they cannot possibly handle.
For better players it was often trivial to push early enough, even with decks not built for early game wins.
She should now be killable even in her final form, but for those playing her it should also be easier to obtain that payoff and create the biggest unit in the game.


Quality of Life

The Boomer family (Boomer, Reboomer and Gax) have received a visual upgrade, making them look a little more unstable and ready to blow!
Last Stand now has a Card Buff indicating when it will cast the better version of the Spell.
Streamlined some flow in the early intro to keep new people engaged.
Added slightly more oomph to the bracket wins in the MMPGQ
Polished the FX on Supreme and Legendary cards in the Power Tower spin
Tweaked the progress bar for guaranteed rare tokens.
Something mysterious starts in 14 days..
Tweaked the description for the 7500 Rubies in the Steam confirmation window
Queue Master wait time increased so it does not appear immediately before you find a match.
Tweaked the Future Past and Future Present cards to use different wording for X-cost cards.
Lady luck visited the game..


Bug Fixes

Fixed a visual issue where King Puff’s staff would not be affected by the stun animations
Fixed a bug where the Healing Shrine would not project healing properly, causing enemies to detarget too early.
Fixed a bug where Challenges would not show any options if clicked before using a Spin Token.
Fixed an issue where you could not watch replays from an opponent’s view
Fixed a visual bug where the mute and hide/show chat button tooltips would show on the wrong side of the screen.
Fixed some buttons being unclickable with a controller 
Fixed a bug where you could quit to desktop in Draft and not receive a loss.
Fixed a bug where Gax would explode when hit by a Wizard Puffs polymorph - Thanks Sinilil.
Fixed an issue with using -10s in replays crashing the game.
Fixed a bug where achievements would not register in Team Battle
Fixed an issue where the Skybox in a match would not be the same for all players



Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 40 - When things change..
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

We want to start by thanking you all for the feedback you’ve provided during the Beta, and most recently regarding the draft changes.
We quickly realized that something was wrong, and have made another iteration of the system which aims to accomplish the good parts of both of the previous versions.

Besides that, we figured it was time to celebrate our 40th update by shaking up the meta a little more than usual, and finally getting around to changing the Defenso Chopper model so new players won’t be horribly confused by the fact that it looks flying but isn’t.


Draft reward rework redux!

Increased and reshuffled the random rewards for all wins, guaranteeing cards in many situations
The guaranteed gold reward has been increased.
Removed Rubies from random rewards.

Overall the rewards are more dependable now, and you should never end up in a situation where you got less value out of the draft than you paid to enter, or that the time spent wasn’t worth it. It’s also possible to play drafts continuously if you do well, although the mode no longer allows you to farm premium currency or massive amounts of gold with them.


Defenso Chopper rework

New model! The Scrats were tired of the chopper, so they decided to make it a chopper instead. The new chopper has a chopper attached for chopping up enemies.
Stat changes:
	Speed down from 5 to 4.
	Range up from .6 to 2 (still technically melee, but just longer)
	Damage up from 30 to 50
	Attack speed from 2.2 to 3 (dps up from 13.6 to 16.7)
	Return damage up from 80 to 100
	 Updated card art



Balance

Blood Imps 
	
Changed to be “Their Master loses health equal to the damage they take. Even Overkill”.
Damage down from 20 to 10, Attack speed from 1.2 to 1.

--- Developer comments ---
The Blood Imps have been in our sights for a while, as they’ve been popular in many strategies because of their versatility and unique mechanic of costing no mana but sacrificing health.
In general they warranted a change so the card gave less value on the board, but the ability for some Masters to specifically avoid the drawback entirely enabled some strategies that quite clearly weren’t doing any good for the game.
This change converts the damage the Blood Imps take into health loss for the Master, bypassing shields.
They still synergize quite well with Masters that are able to avoid other damage sources, but the Imps themselves will now always carry a cost for the immense value they can provide.

Milloween - Arcane Missiles damage per missile up from 30 to 40.
--- Developer comments ---
Milloween still hasn’t reached her full potential, and we believe in part it’s because her early game presence suffered under a costly spell that didn’t necessarily provide much value.
Other changes in this update should give her more powerful tools, but we felt the Spell should at least have the potential to give an advantage when played right.

Daggerfall
	
Damage up from 50 to 80
Cast delay down from 2 sec to 1.5 sec

--- Developer comments ---
Daggerfall quite clearly wasn’t as powerful as you’d expect of a 3 mana card. The damage increase helps it deal with a larger set of Minions, which makes it an actual alternative to Fireball, Chain Lightning and Shock Rock.
It also brings the spell into a range where it can kill priority targets like Xiao Long, allowing you to remove him from the board without a mana loss.
The delay on the spell also made it feel oddly unresponsive, despite being just as fast as fireball. Lowering the delay makes it feel better, but also allows it to react faster, killing things such as Boomers in the hands of a skilled player, which should further provide some nuances to decisions around which lower cost spells to include in your deck.

Styxi - Health up from 70 to 90
--- Developer comments ---
A necessary change because of the Daggerfall increase, but also a small increase to a very costly minion, making it harder to kill with smaller chip attacks like Shock Rock.

Prowler
	
Pounce cooldown up from 1 sec to 3 sec
Pounce minimum range up from 2 to 4.

--- Developer comments ---
The Prowler’s pounce has been nice and impactful, but it felt unnaturally quick to resume pouncing once it had killed things. It also had the ability to pounce on things that were very close, which didn’t feel right in most cases.
This change emphasizes the opponent’s ability to place things in front of the Prowler to avoid the initial damage, while still maintaining the strength of the card in most places.

Dragon Nest
	
Changed to “Summons a Dragon Whelp when its Master plays a 3-cost or higher Spell”
Health up from 150 to 250, Duration up from 20 to 30, Mana cost down from 4 to 3.

--- Developer comments ---
The Dragon Nest has had a few issues for a while.
For one, when Spirit Infusion became popular it became very much a card centered around one big push that was extremely hard to deal with.
Buff Spells and lower cost Spells also provided the Dragon Nest with a carefree way of producing dragons. Lower cost spells had an instant mana gain, no matter how you played the Spell, and Buff Spells like Spirit Infusion and Rampage almost always gave the player value since they could be used on the Dragons themselves.
While we like the Dragon Nest’s ability to enable different strategies, the current versions were simply not fun to play against, mostly because they were extremely punishing for the unprepared.
The change to Dragon Nest forces players to gain value from the Spells they’re playing in order to regain the investment in the Dragon Nest. Additionally, this change combined with the Spirit Infusion mana and spirit reduction below, results in Spirit Infusion simply not triggering the Dragon Nest.
We targeted Spirit Infusion specifically because it made it extremely difficult to deal with the dragons, as any counter you would normally use was invalidated by the buffs.
One last thing we’d like to mention, is that this change also aimed to reduce the stress of playing Dragon Nest.
The previous version quickly ran out, which meant you had to fire off your combo quickly or lose the whole thing. This was rather stressful, and forced you to spend a lot of time setting up the Dragon Nest combo to get maximum value out of it. The new Dragon Nest still gains something from including smaller Spells through their utility and synergy, but not directly as a combo.

Spirit Infusion
	
Number of Spirits down from 3 to 2
Mana cost down from 3 to 2

--- Developer comments ---
Spirit Infusion was changed for many of the reasons stated above under Dragon Nest, but additionally, we felt it was very hard to foresee how the board would be in 9 seconds time, so it was often very hard to gain any value from the last spirit.
The Spell is also rather hard to counterplay, and while reducing the mana cost may lead to more possible synergies, this change makes it harder to grow a specific Minion to immense size, which in turn limits the effect it has on the opponent’s ability to counter the Minion.

Call to Arms - Mana cost down from 3 to 2
--- Developer comments ---
Since the rework of Call to Arms before Team Battle, the card hasn’t seen as much play as we’d hoped. We felt it was very hard to use, because you were forced to gain value from the Buildings you had played. While our philosophy on what it should require to play hasn’t changed, we believe it was simply too difficult, and thus warranted a small reduction in cost. This makes it easier to gain the return on investment from the buildings and still use them as Warriors, rather than never getting to play the card.
Aside from that, the recent mana reduction to Dragon Nest enabled an extremely easy combo where you could gain mana without any possibility for the opponent to counterplay it.

Quality of Life

The Loading Icon on loading screens is now bigger.
A small sound now plays when somebody uses an emote.
Season Reset calculations now happen as players log in, making the downtime around Season Resets much shorter.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a visual issue where the “eligible space” graphics would show when the teammate was placing units in Team Battle.
Fixed a bug where returning to the main menu after an error would lock the game.
The escape menu now properly opens the initial menu if opened after having seen the leave warning in Team Battle
Fixed a bug where the tooltip to inspect opponents’ cards wouldn’t disappear if you clicked the wrong opponent
Fixed a bug where the other Master would get Stormbringers Marksmanship buff in Team Battle.
Fixed a visual issue with the greyed out placement preview for your teammate applying to your preview instead.
Fixed an issue where Gax would not explode properly if protected by Guardian’s Shield and trying to kill himself.
Fixed a sound bug where the Master’s Voice Over would be panned to the left in the Main Menu
Fixed all accented characters missing in Italian - Thanks PixyLeeSwagger
Fixed a bug where Ravager would stop attacking other units because another unit was within his range plus the buffer range for staying on the same target. - Thanks Videogamer7777777_91
The Healing Shrine now properly plays SFX
Fixed the Battle Shi-Hou sometimes having a giant arrow indication for nearby Minions.
Corrected the formatting of the German translation of Damage
Fixed an issue where Tommy the Dummy would be up by default in the intro cinematic.
Fixed a bug where the Loading Tips would should prototype cards for a certain upcoming feature.
Fixed an issue where two Settsu’s landing at the same time caused one’s logic to stop
Gax’s World Damage string is now correctly localized.
Fixed a visual issue where Spiritmancer and Blastmancers attack VFX would sometimes disappear
The initial Draft menu with purchase options no longer shows the average mana of your previous draft deck
Fixed an issue where units would retarget away from the Troubadour when the Troubadour was stunned. - Thanks Greywolf
Fixed a UI bug where a locked Master would be displayed when you joined a friend lobby
Fixed a follow-up issue with the Musketeer’s parry cooldown sometimes running while he was stunned
Fixed a bug where the Musketeer would not perform his Riposte attack after blocking an attack
Fixed a bug with the Musketeer walking in place instead of moving - Thanks PakoMANIAC
The Musketeer can no longer target invisible units with his Riposte attack - Thanks Sinilil
Fixed a bug with the matchmaking in Team Battle that would match two higher ranked players against two lower ranked players.


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 40 - When things change..
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

We want to start by thanking you all for the feedback you’ve provided during the Beta, and most recently regarding the draft changes.
We quickly realized that something was wrong, and have made another iteration of the system which aims to accomplish the good parts of both of the previous versions.

Besides that, we figured it was time to celebrate our 40th update by shaking up the meta a little more than usual, and finally getting around to changing the Defenso Chopper model so new players won’t be horribly confused by the fact that it looks flying but isn’t.


Draft reward rework redux!

Increased and reshuffled the random rewards for all wins, guaranteeing cards in many situations
The guaranteed gold reward has been increased.
Removed Rubies from random rewards.

Overall the rewards are more dependable now, and you should never end up in a situation where you got less value out of the draft than you paid to enter, or that the time spent wasn’t worth it. It’s also possible to play drafts continuously if you do well, although the mode no longer allows you to farm premium currency or massive amounts of gold with them.


Defenso Chopper rework

	Range up from .6 to 2 (still technically melee, but just longer)

notes.title: Update 39 - Daily Draft Deluxx!
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

We’ve had our eye on the Draft mode since the release, and have known a change was needed in relation to the rewards.
It seemed the appropriate time, as we’re rolling out the Daily Draft event which will hopefully bring a lot of people to try out the mode and see the new reward system for themselves.

NEW Event - Daily Draft!

The Daily Draft event, like the name implies, grants every player a free Draft every day


Draft reward and entry rework!

Draft Tickets now cost 750 gold or 55 rubies
There is no longer a guaranteed spin token in the draft rewards
Random Draft rewards changed towards providing more cards, shards and spin tokens, especially for higher win outcomes.
Rewards reduced appropriately to the price change


Quality of Life

Reworked a number of things for better matches in Team Battle. This has affected a lot of things behind the scenes, but everything should look the same :)
Black hole now also has team-colour particles for the whole duration
Added a round-off screen for the MMPGQ after players finished the tutorial.
Added a celebration cinematic when the Stormbringer defeats Ratbo in the MMPGQ
Admins are now coloured red in the chat
Added random dialogue bits to Settsu’s Blast entry
Hypnotize now has a Team colour indicator while casting.
The replay overview now shows which Masters were involved in a game.
The placement preview graphics are now grey for the second player on a team


Bug Fixes

Fixed a rare NullReferenceException for the Laser Turret attack
Fixed a bug with Stormbringer’s bowstring not showing
FIxed a visual issue with Infiltration’s visual indicator disappearing beneath certain visual effects (snow/gold arena)
Fixed a bug with Milloween’s Arcane Golem becoming small after multiple buffs - Thanks Edelweiss
Fixed Healing Shrines VFX circle not showing properly on bridges


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 38 - A Moment of Peace
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

Things at the Dwarf Fortress are peaceful. With some empty seats because of summer vacations an eerie calm has settled over the Dwarves.
They still had time to make some cool features for you - requests for Team Battle improvements, other UI niceness and a new card, which will give you the feeling of peace that everyone’s experiencing. That is, when you’re not frantically trying to place the Healing Shrine in time to heal that Blue Golem before a Beam of Doom kills it.


NEW Card

Healing Shrine - This short-lived Building will rapidly heal nearby friendly Minions.


Balance

Guardian - The Shield Ally ability no longer prevents Building decay.


Quality of Life

The host of a custom game can no longer start the next game while others are looking at the match summary screen.
You can now see your ally’s deck in the match summary screen after a Team Battle
Removed an outdated “You’re ready for online play” message that would appear while playing solo challenges.
The Level Rewards list in the profile screen now goes upwards instead of downwards, because you go up in levels!
Removed “Claim points” for the Season Reset screen if there were no points for the given rank.
The global chat now replaces ß with ss in names - Thanks Edelweiß
You can now see your partners Premade Team rank in the lobby before searching.
There is now a penalty for leaving Solo Queue Team Battle games - leaving a game before it ends prohibits you from searching for Team Battle games for 5 minutes. A warning has been introduced when clicking quit in-game.
The Matchmaking for Solo Queue Team Battle games now further weighs matching players closer to each other in rank based on the difference in individual rank rather than average of the potential team.
A message now appears if the game closes down improperly, suggesting you report crashes on the forums or change your graphics settings.
Something mysterious starts in 7 days..
Additional tweaks to the intro flow, hiding some menus and information that isn’t relevant in certain situations before level 6.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with Laser Turret causing crashes
Fixed a bug where Raging Reinforcements would be oriented the wrong way
Fixed an error with the Musketeer trying to run logic for his parry VFX despite being dead.
Fixed a visual bug where hovering over a card in Team Battle would display the mana cost on your mana bar wrongly.
Fixed C-SAR using his “Well played” VO when a replay started.
Fixed some issue with Animator errors appearing when entering the Main Menu


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 37 - Regular in the Random
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

A small update this time, as we bring you a number of fixes and improvements.
Highlights include fixing regular cards in draft, incorrect “incorrect match result” reports and tutorial improvements.
Note that we changed the initial volumes to be higher.

Quality of Life

The Italian translation has been improved, a big thanks to Simone “Chibi84” Cirimbilla
Made a number of improvements to the initial flow after the Tutorial battles to guide new players in learning the game.
Further improvements to the Tutorial battles - voiceline timings, better initial game logo animation, Ratbo talks, scaling music and more.
Added an option in Image Effects to disable the smooth camera movement when moving the mouse.
The creaking sounds in the main menu have been replaced with windy sounds, to fit better with all arenas.
Reduced Ghost Turret ragdoll’s emission
Added Team Colour indication on Black Hole.
Replaced Drone Force One with Sniper Scrat in the Hard Stormbringer Challenge
Tweaked some emissions on shields such as Divine Warrior and Shielded Crossbow Dudes
Removed the Loading Tips from the loading screen when starting the game.
Emoticons and Channels are no longer case sensitive in the Global chat
Adjusted Max and initial Volume in audio - it’s higher now!


Bug fixes

Fixed an issue where regular cards would not be included in Draft
Fixed an issue where the vs screen in Team Battle would sometimes be skipped.
Fixed the issue where people could get stuck on the loading screen in Battle and Draft mode when they had played a Team Battle game - Thanks RushSecond, and everyone else who reported it!
Master can no longer interrupt C-SAR when he’s talking. Know your place, Masters!
Fixed the Demon Warrior ragdoll behaving weirdly when she had multiple stacks - Thanks King Puff Cup 6!
Fixed a bug where the UI would disappear when you previewed the Troubadour in the Deckbuilding menu - Thanks [TB] TheRussianSpy, and others!
Fixed an issue where converting the Demon Warrior with a Ghost would make her small, although she maintained her stacks.
Fixed the ranking for Grandmasters showing a completely made up number in the main menu. Thanks VideoGamer7777777_91!
Reverted some FX changes that were causing some crashes.
Fixed holes in the Level Up glow effect in-game.
Fixed the Curse, Stun and other FX only affecting the hand of a Blue Golem.
Fixed an issue where a card would be added to the hand multiple times - Thanks FFA
Fixed the Boomer not exploding when chasing big units like the Troubadour - Thanks Edelweiss
Fixed the tooltips for currencies no longer displaying when hovering.
Fixed controller cursor being stuck on screen when moving the mouse cursor out of the screen.
King Puff’s 3rd perk now properly says X/1 where X is the number of bridges he controls.
Fixed a number of issues with the new Tutorial related to Bad and Ugly settings
Fixed an issue with the Chain Lightning indicator arrows being the wrong team colour
Fixed Mordar’s Tombstones being able to Revive Settsu (again)
Fixed the Musketeer removing stun on himself if his Parry came off cooldown while he was stunned.
Fixed an issue where winning players would be incorrectly flagged for reporting an incorrect match result and thus lose.
Fixed a bug with Master selection in Draft where multiple Drafts would make the UI display the previous selection rather than the ones you were selecting.

Tutorial improvements

Added Intro Cinematic
Tweaked all C-SAR voice lines for the tutorial fights
Reworked the UI between matches to be the Minion Masters Pan-Galactic Qualifiers
Changed Ratbo’s arena and skybox

Gax now properly receives +100% damage from rage

Sounds in the tutorial now pause when you pause the game.
Added spotlight FX to the Night Stadium skybox
Added a number of new localizations
The confirmation for increasing settings no longer allows you to revert.
Tweaked the Emoji menu to stay longer when trying to select an emoji
Added Spell Icons when targeting for all Master Spells

Changed some Season Reset data handling on startup
Improved some data handling as a result of the ranking reset.
Improved AI targeting, making them able to hit e.g. Swarmers with a Beam of Doom
Added all existing cards as Loading Tips
Loading Tips are now displayed in the loading screen going out of a match
Beam of Doom now has team colour indication
The /help command in the chat now has help for Emoticons
Changed initial volume levels to 80%
Added a Glorious visual setting and moved the recent point light additions to that setting. The default setting is still Beautiful

Fixed a bug where continuing a Queue Master fight would result in having an empty hand.
Fixed a typo in Ravager’s description saying trough rather than through - Thanks SwampyMuffinz
Fixed a SplatMap shader not working with snow
Fixed some bugs with Master Towers’ colour and emissions
Fixed a bug with Bridge Shrines’ emissions not displaying properly
Fixed skyboxes changing every time you used the -10s function in replays
Fixed an issue on the Team Battle match summary screen where you had to click twice to view the middle opponent’s deck when already viewing the second opponent’s deck.
Fixed the New Card UI label disappearing when you quit the game.
Fixed an issue where people could cancel their search after finding a match
Match summary data is now handled upon match completion rather than over time
Fixed an issue with a Match ending in an error due to missing player data.
Fixed an issue where units entering a Black Hole while their health has the white damaged part would make their healthbars entirely white after they got out of the Black Hole
Fixed an issue where the Chat would start open when you returned to the main menu in certain situations
Fixed an issue where the chat would only display a date instead of the welcome message
Fixed some issues with music starting wrongly when a Master was at low health.
Fixed an issue where the Spiritmancer card would be outside its borders on the Leaderboard
Fixed an issue with King Puff’s Trick Swap not displaying its FX properly in Team Battle - Thanks Eazotop


And thank you to all the people who provide feedback on the forums, even if we forgot to put your name on the list :)
 
Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 35 - Join the King Puff Cup 2vs2 tournament!
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!
 
We’re excited about how you’ve all been hammering the Team Battle mode with many exciting strategies only possible when you work together.
The event continues for another week, whereupon we will disable 2 vs 2 for a period to make some improvements.
During this final week, you will also get one extra daily quest - the Team Battle Tryout quest.
 
This week we’ve got a lot of fixes and some balance changes for you, but much more exciting is the fact that the King Puff Cup is running a 2 vs 2 tournament this weekend!
 
The Dwarves will be watching this with ale in hand, so sign up and show us who the real Minion Masters are!
 
It’s easy to sign up, just go here
 
Rules are found in the original forum post
 
Changelog
 
Balance

Spirit Vessel - Damage from 35 to 40
--- Developer comments ---
The Spirit Vessel was assumed to provide more value than a Warrior since you could get the Spirit on something that would better utilize it.
Unfortunately, the potential of this hasn’t been enough to make Spirit Vessel popular.
This slight buff to damage will hopefully make the Spirit Vessel a more viable medium-range tank.
 
Warrior and Divine Warrior - Damage from 60 to 70
--- Developer comments ---
The Warriors haven’t seen much action since the big Call to Arms rework. While the Warrior is a strong tank with good value, the lack of a special mechanic makes it hard to get value out of at higher levels.
Coming back to Call to Arms, it’s also relevant that getting value from that is very hard with the new version, so we increased the reward from getting a good Call to Arms setup.
Lastly, the change also helps the Divine Warrior stand alone by accomplishing something while her shield is up, rather than needing backup to gain value from it.
 
Stun Blast - Duration from 6 to 5
--- Developer comments ---
Stun Blast can be rather frustrating to play against and has been included in a lot of very aggressive decks since the mana reduction. The potential of a good timing is still there with this change, but you’ll have to be slightly more careful about the timing.
 
Milloween - Basic attack damage per Arcane Spark up from 8 to 10
--- Developer comments ---
Milloween has has a problem with being a Master who could really only do one or two strategies. While she was obviously intended to be focused on Spells, the fact that you had to include Dragon Nest or bet everything on your Arcane Golem made her rather limited.
This change helps her defend herself, and makes her able to defend herself rather handily with a full hand of Spells, which should benefit most strategies using her.
 
King Puff - Basic attack Attack Speed from 2.25 to 2.5. Range reduced from 10 to 8.
--- Developer comments ---
We’ve been keeping a close eye on King Puff for a while, and despite his slightly diminishing popularity compared to the previous Season, we believe he is still a little too strong in some aspects.
His powerful basic attack allows him to ignore many units, especially once he unlocks the third perk, but his abilities have also started to show a lot of potential at many different levels of play.
We’re scaling his basic attack a little so it’s slower, but also finally reintroducing the idea of a Master with a slightly lower range than others. This makes for a few interesting dynamics when King Puff faces off against Stormbringer, or decks including long range units like the Mancers.
 
S.T.INT - Health from 85 to 80
--- Developer comments ---
The S.T.INT. has still been very popular and feels like a card you often want to include in your deck. While we’re still waiting to see the effects of the previous change, we feels it’s still strong and also wanted to bring it more in line with other interactions. Putting it at 80 health leaves it at a different threshold, as it will now take 1 less hit to kill it from many units, which should weaken it more than such a small change suggests.

 
Misc

Introduced pages for the Master Selection GUI and Shop. Temporarily removed the ? entry to avoid a page with nothing but a teaser. Don’t worry, we’re still working on it ;)
Removed the “Card Play Failed” message when your teammates card failed to play in Team Battle.
Disabled the ability for non-hosts of a lobby to stop searching for a game
Moved the Replay GUI back to the lower left.
Chain Lightning’s placement circle is now blue or red depending on whether a teammate or enemy played it.
Prepared the shop for something special..
Added a countdown for the Team Battle event in the menu
Settsu can no longer be revived by Mordar’s tombstone
During the final week of the Team Battle event, an extra quest will be granted every day.
 
Fixed a number of issues with the July Season Reset causing ranks and rewards to be given multiple times and disappearing.
Fixed an issue where the shop “Locked until level 7” tooltip would appear far from the cursor
Fixed the card play/summoning effects playing for both masters in Team Battle when only one player played a card
Fixed an issue with the pre-placement sound FX playing multiple times on top of each other in Team Battle
Fixed the Musketeer card art being low resolution at lower settings
Fixed an issue where you couldn’t change the Master linked to a deck once you’d had a lobby open
Fixed some issues with the Master being changed to Stormbringer when you exited a menu while looking at locked Masters. It now selects your last selected Master.
Fixed not being able to rotate arenas with mouse-drag in arena selection
Fixed Settsu gaining the benefits of Perk 3 at level 2.
Fixed Xiao Long’s card buffs staying on cards in Team Battle even after Xiao Long died.
Fixed Stormbringer’s Marksmanship buff stacking when playing with two Stormbringers in Team Battle.
Fixed an issue with your Teammates hand in a Team Battle replay showing wrongly.
Fixed an issue where King Puff’s third perk would not make his team properly immune in Team Battle if he was player 3 or 4.
Fixed an issue with Prowler and Musketeer causing their targets to become untargetable if they died while charging.
Fixed an issue where you could play with an unowned Master by selecting him during matchmaking
Corrected Styxi’s description from “miss” to “misses”
Fixed an issue with some skyboxes causing players that had unselected Bloom to have flipped screens in-game.
Fixed an issue with Reboomer not causing the Succubus to blink if she survived the explosion
Fixed Team Battle decks appearing on the Battle leaderboards.

 
Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 34 - Team Battle Event!
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

This week marks the start of our Team Battle event, where you can play with friends or strangers and finally try out that ridiculous combo you came up with but needed 16 cards to make work.

There are now three ladders:


Each rank only resets when the Season does, so your premade rank is the same no matter which friend you play with.
You can also play Friend Team Battles by inviting 3 friends to the same lobby. There is no ranking in friend battles, just like in the Battle mode.

But how does it actually work in the game?
It’s actually really simple; There’s two Masters on the Master Tower. Health is increased and each Master has their own mana and hand, although mana is reduced a little.
XP is shared, so both Masters on a team level up together.

The event will run for two weeks, but Team Battles will stay afterwards - perhaps being disabled for short periods while in Beta.

Free Legendary card - Musketeer
Those who completed the Best of Brawny event will automatically get the new Legendary card - Musketeer for their collection. It’s also available for crafting by anyone.


He’s an elite fighter of the Slither Servants, trained for decades in the art of fencing and agile maneuvers.
The Musketeer has the ability to avoid an attack with a parry, though he is still vulnerable to spells.
If an enemy is nearby after a parry, he can riposte for critical damage.
After parrying, it takes a short time for him to be able to parry again.

Misc

Season Reset - Ranking points gained for each Wood rank climbed increased from 0 to 50.
Introduced icons and Rank title to better identify which is currently active.
Reworked Mordar’s Basic Attack VFX to be clearer and fit with his channeling pulses.
Added a new skybox - Stadium Lights
New massive graphical improvement using Unity’s Post-Processing Stack. This shows a noticeable difference on lights, bloom and many other things.
Added better lights on Braziers for arenas and bridges
Unit spawning spells with a delay now leave a small beacon to indicate where you cast it. This affects Infiltration and Settsu’s Blast Entry. The beacon is not visible to the opponent.
Hid the Draft Average Mana icon until the first card is selected.
Changed text when finding a match from “Online Match Found” to “Match Found”
Reduced the frequency of Masters’ Overkill voicelines
Polished Settsu’s High-Powered Laser shot so the damage occurs more in line with the effects.
Added a cursor indicator to the Deckbuilding Search field.
Improved the feedback players get if trying to join a lobby that was already full.
Polished Sniper Scrat setup animations based on their new attack speed.
Updated Stormbringer’s ragdoll to the new model
Moved the Solo Challenges to the fourth space in the main menu.

Fixed a number of issues with Win Statistics being inaccurate. This is a work in progress ;)
Fixed an issue where units with stacks would display 10 with the numbers on different lines.
Fixed an issue where Settsu would not fire her High-Powered Laser correctly if she turned level 3 on the field and hadn’t shot a bullet yet. -Thank you King Puff Cup 5.
Fixed an issue where the Prowler would break if stunned during a jump - Thank you Edelweiss
Fixed an issue where enemies would detarget the Tranquil Shi-Hou because they predicted he would die from attacks that he then outhealed. -Thanks Hyanen
Fixed an issue with Ratbo gaining massive bursts of attack speed if stunned during More Dakka! Casting.
Fixed an issue with C-SAR announcing the wrong team was at low health.
Fixed an issue with hypnotize’s animation ending wrongly.
Fixed an issue with Styxi’s Laser sight not pointing in the same direction as his weapon.
Fixed an issue where Gax would refuse to explode when taunted by the Troubadour - Thanks Khazlariko
Fixed Priestess sometimes showing  healing VFX on things inside a Black Hole.
Fixed the lobby gui showing when you had left a lobby in some cases
Fixed an issue with Prowler performing weird pounces while rooted by a Snake Druid

 
Cheers from BetaDwarf!

After a delay, we've finally got Update 33 ready for you!

What a show!
 
With an overwhelming victory in the Best of Brawny finals, it is quite clear that Apep not only has worshippers in the Slither Servants faction, but also in the Minion Masters community!
Worship the serpent god, and he will bestow upon you the gift of power, as he brings the Musketeer from his armies to the show.
 
The Musketeer will enter the show next week in update 34.
He’s an elite fighter of the Slither Servants, trained for decades in the art of fencing and agile maneuvers.
The Musketeer has the ability to avoid an attack with a parry, though he is still vulnerable to spells.
If an enemy is nearby after a parry, he can riposte for critical damage.
After parrying, it takes a short time for him to be able to parry again.
 
We mentioned in the event that you would have the opportunity to influence the design of the winning card, but we’re saving that for another time because it doesn’t make sense this time around.
We’d like to put the Musketeer in your hands as early as possible after the event, but polling delays the whole process, and puts us at risk of running into more bugs and unforeseen issues.
 
We also believe it would be hard for you to give input on card stats for a concept you haven’t played with at all. At the same time these stats may need balancing later, in which case your choices may be negated.
We’ll figure out a good way to do something within the spirit of the original idea in the future, because we’d love to get your input on the direction of the game
Thank you for your understanding.
 
Balance

Xiao Long - Spell Punish damage up from 150 to 250
--- Developer comments ---
Xiao Long didn’t provide the exciting match focus and dilemma we had hoped for.
It was supposed to offer a choice for the opponent on how he played his cards, as the order and specific allocation became much more important - did you remove Xiao Long first or could you accept taking the damage?
However, it often didn’t have enough of an effect, and including it in your deck meant you sometimes got a little extra damage directly on the enemy, but at a low efficiency, especially considering the Minion itself lost most of its fights.
This change emphasizes his mechanic, and we’re hoping people can use him not just as a counter strategy to spell-heavy decks, but also to cover the weaknesses of decks especially prone to spells.
 
Styxi - fixed a bug where he would take 4 seconds to shoot again after killing an enemy, rather than the 2 seconds listed
--- Developer comments ---
This is more of a bug fix, but we’re listing it in balance because it has a profound impact on Styxi’s ability to handle swarms.
This not only sets him more apart from the regular snipers given the recent change to them, but also gives him a wider breadth of things to handle.
We’re still considering more tweaks to his balance, but would like to see the effects of this fix first.
 
Settsu - High-Powered Laser shots no longer hit enemies behind Settsu.
--- Developer comments ---
While we don’t currently feel the ability is too strong, we did think the High-Powered Laser could be extremely frustrating in some situations because of the stun. The fact that it hit enemies behind Settsu meant there was very little counter-play to her outside of stunning her, even when she was on your field!
This change makes it possible to use positioning to take out Settsu, especially if she’s currently focusing on the enemy Master.
 
Bridge colliders are now slightly wider, extending them further towards the middle gap.
--- Developer comments ---
Also more of a bug fix, but it changes balance a bit - We found some cases with flying Minions and Minions pushed out of the middle gap where the Bridge wouldn’t be captured when it should have - Thanks Khazlariko

 
Misc

Introduced a lobby system to custom games. You must now create a lobby before inviting friends to a challenge. This was done to make it easier to understand how to play against friends, but also in preparation for the upcoming Team Battle mode.
Offensive Spawner spells (Infiltration and Blast Entry) now have GUI indications for eligible areas, and warn for Out of Bounds when trying to cast outside the areas.
Updated Sniper Scrat description to reflect the recent changes.
Added an extra . to the “Searching..” text on battle buttons - Thanks Omicron666
Scaled up the Warrior’s ragdoll to reflect her model size.
Renamed the online modes to Battle and Draft
Removed a ; from Stormbringers perk 2 description
Xiao Long’s Spell Punish ability now shows as Card Buffs on the opponent’s cards, warning him of the consequences.
Xiao Long’s description now says “they use a Spell” instead of “he uses a Spell”
Changed some spawn FX to fit more with C-SAR’s theme.
Added average mana cost indicator to Draft deckbuilding.
Polished some of the effects of the new shaders on lower quality settings based on user feedback.
Prepared a lot of data for the upcoming 2v2 mode - this is what caused the update to be so complex.
 
Fixed an issue where card details would sometimes not appear when getting a reward, leaving you in a stuck state
Fixed an issue where Ghost taking over Dragon Nest would cause Spells from both players to trigger it, even after death. Thanks PakoManiac & NuclearGoo
Fixed level up text saying “Draft Draft Ticket” for level 9. It is now Draft & Draft Ticket
Fixed an issue where using a Beam of Doom while another Beam of Doom was already firing made it visually glitch
Fixed the Warrior’s preview animation initial state being standing (she would sit down then get up)
Fixed an issue with the Streamer icon in chat being a Puff rather than a Twitch icon.
Fixed the Sniper Scrat sound FX being out of sync with the new attack
Fixed some issues with missing spaces after / in page-based menus

 
Feel the Might of Apep!

notes.title: Update 32 - Careful aim
notes.notes:
Greetings Masters,!
 
The Best of Brawny finals are well underway, with the results heavily favoring Apep so far.
Remember that you’ll get the card no matter which Master you select, but which card it is depends on who the community supported the most. There’s still 7 days left for Volco to make a comeback!

This week we’re bringing you some balance changes to shake up a few things. 
 
Balance

Gax - Damage up from 100 to 150
--- Developer comments ---
Gax was intended to be a board clear type of card with a warning, but unfortunately he never really accomplished that with a damage of 100. With this change, he will now kill many 4 mana cards, and even some 5 mana ones, giving him a greater chance of being worth playing.
Sniper Scrat & Bounty Sniper - Damage up from 50 to 100, Attack cooldown from 3 to 4.
--- Developer comments ---
The Snipers are receiving a buff with a slight rescaling. Besides being a markable increase in DPS, this allows them to handle most flying units much better, and also pose a threat to mid-cost cards. In return, they’re less efficient at taking out swarms.
Spear Throwers - Count up from 3 to 4, Damage down from 20 to 15
--- Developer comments ---
The Spear Throwers received a buff recently, but they’re still not used much outside of Draft play. This buff allows them to more efficiently distribute the damage from their ranged attack, and also gives them more staying power when fighting.
Annihilator - Attack cooldown from 2.5 to 2.1
--- Developer comments ---
The guy with the biggest gun felt a little too clunky, and because of his speed he ended up not countering some cards he theoretically should (I’m looking at you Dragon Pack)
This change mostly emphasizes his ability to counter swarms, but he still remains vulnerable to tanks or high damage spells.
S.T.INT. - Range down from 8 to 6
--- Developer comments ---
The S.T.INT. has been extremely popular since it was released, probably because it traded a little too well with most other low cost cards.
We see this as an opportunity to differentiate it more from other cards by trying a shorter range, which will help melee units get closer, and some ranged units to get the jump on it.

Misc

Made some improvements to player connections during the start of online matches to avoid desyncing the match when a player was loading slower than the other.

Fixed an issue where you could make the reward music play twice on top of each other when skipping Daily Quest reward animations
Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in Card preview or Reward screen when skipping.
Fixed the Queue Master battles resuming without any cards in hand.

 
Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 31 - Best of Brawny
notes.notes:
Masters!
 
It's Tri-Team Tourney Finals Time!
The Masters of Team Brawny will fight each other and see who is the best of the best, better than all the rest.
 
Each Master must fight to gather Keys, which in turn can be used to unlock the Grand Chest, in their name, for a reward. The Master that unlocks the most chests will determine which Legendary card will be awarded to all the players who managed to open a chest during the event.




 
The chosen card will be available one week after the event ends, as a reward for players who opened a chest, and a craftable/spin reward for everyone else!
Good luck everyone, we’re really looking forward to crowning the Tri-Team Champion!
 
Ps. As per community feedback, you will no longer win keys you already have, and you can even still get keys from watching streamers :) 
 
Balance

Living Statue - Health increased from 1000 to 1200 
Living Statue - Damage increased from 100 to 120
--- Developer comments ---
The Living Statue has been out of the high-tier meta for quite a while, and we’d like to see it make a comeback! We want it, and other tougher but less aggressive minions, to provide a miniature conflict that needs to be dealt with or supported respectively. We are aware that the buff, while relatively major, might still not be enough to have it make a comeback, but we are wary of overbalancing it, and want to first see how it is utilized after this buff round.
Blastmancer - Damage increased from 5 to 10
Spiritmancer - Damage increased from 5 to 10
--- Developer comments ---
We felt the Mancers really ought to be better at Mancing, so we gave them some on-the-job training, resulting in a great productivity increase. Their Middle Managers are so proud!

Misc

Fixed an issue with missing error message on Redeem.
Fixed an issue with daily quests sometimes not registering progress.
Fixed a visual issue where the player would sometimes (when Bloom was disabled) appear to be on the right side of the playing field, but was still required to play cards from the left.
Fixed a problem where the Prowler would do a weird follow the leader dance when targeting the Rammer, instead of attacking him. Now it properly makes short work of him, the poor guy.
Trickswapping the prowler mid jump will now break the jump.
Fixed an issue where spells would refuse to show their effect area when being cast. We gave them a stern talking to, and they have agreed to fall in line.
Fixed a visual issue where some ground shaders would not display inbuilt ao properly.
Fixed spells not giving proper out of bounds feedback
Fixed lots of small shader bugs stemming from the big shader update. Please do tell us if you notice more!
Shock Rock now always stuns before dealing damage.
Ghosted Dragon Nests will no longer spawn dragons when both players play spells.

 
Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 30 - Is it a bird? Is it a plane? It’s a Prowler!
notes.notes:
Masters!

This week we’re bringing some very requested changes to the game - the Prowler card and balance changes to the Crossbow Dude cards.


NEW Card

Prowler
This monstrous hunter hails from the garden world where the Snake Gods rule. Its powerful pounce will not allow any enemies to escape.


Balance

Crossbow Dudes - Damage up from 10 to 15, Attack cooldown up from 1.5 to 1.6 sec.
--- Developer comments ---
The Crossbow Dude card took a heavy nerf some time ago, since it was a very overused card.
However, the state of the card ended up so weakened that most players don’t even include it anymore, which certainly wasn’t the intention.
This change increases their DPS significantly, but maintains a relatively slow attack speed for such small units, which still sets them apart from the Plasma Marines in more than mana cost.

Shielded Crossbow Dudes - Count down from 4 to 3
--- Developer comments ---
The buff to Crossbow dudes inevitably affects the other cards that utilize them, and a buff to them would need to be accompanied by changes to Shielded Crossbow Dudes to not unbalance that card.
At the same time, we’ve been seeing the Shielded Crossbow Dudes used heavily in King Puff decks, while not seeing much play elsewhere, mostly because of their great synergy with Inspire.
Reducing their count but increasing the power of each Dude as per the other change, rebalances the card to have slightly higher dps in total, but with less health on the board and less synergy with Inspire.
Raging Reinforcements - Crossbow Dude group count down from 4 to 3
--- Developer comments ---
With the increased power of each Dude, we had to reduce the counting in Raging Reinforcements to maintain balance.

Misc

Reworked the entire text system for the game for a higher quality text with fewer visual glitches
Call To Arms is no longer a Defensive spell (can be cast anywhere)
Fixed a small issue with Elite Swarmers animation during placement
Fixed an issue with some currencies displaying as ??
C-SAR now has a bunch of a new voice lines for crafting, level up and more!
Users can now use /syncachievements if acheivements in Steam and in-game are out of sync
Snake Druid now has a different death sound from Crossbow Dudes
Added spectators to the default arenas
Fixed a visual glitch with Stormbringers arrows appearing from his chest rather than his bow.
Improved Shields in preview models
Assassin now uses a different animation for his attack when not dealing critical damage
Living Statue now has its own SFX set
Added SFX on Boomer in the preview
Added SFX on Shielded Crossbow Dudes in preview
Changed SFX on Cannon Rollers preview
Overhauled all shaders, making for an improved visual expression overall.
Stormbringer has received an updated Master Icon



Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 29 - Give it up for Team Brawny!
notes.notes:
What a show!

We were truly on the edge of our seats as Team Brainy almost beat Brawny for the ultimate prize!

Ok, fine, it was pretty much decided from the beginning, but a few loyal Masters out there really gave it their best. Team Brainy and Bloody can rightfully be proud of their attempts!

Glory be to Team Brawny, the best of the best, the Masters of Minion Masters, and winners of the Tri-Team Tourney.

This will be remembered for eons to come - or at least until the next big thing happens - and it will affect future events.


With the Tri-Team Tourney finished, the two cards included in the prize chest are now available to all through the spins, and we’re looking forward to seeing them played again and again and again..


NEW Cards

S.T.INT
The Single-Track Interceptor - or S.T.INT - is fast, agile and packs quite a punch for its size. Can’t take much punishment though

Guardian
This hunk of health guards nearby allies, absorbing any damage they take.



Balance

Soul Stealer - Mana cost down from 6 to 5
--- Developer comments ---
The Soul Stealer hasn’t seen much play because it’s a rather niche card. It’s not particularly good at countering anything for a defense, rather it “counters” swarm decks by using their strength to create a strong push of its own.
However, due to his low health, he was easily removed even when he got the stacks needed to pose a threat to the enemy Master.
With this change, he should be easier to get value out of, meaning he can be played in more situations, and has a greater reason to be included in a deck.


Scrat Horde - Mana cost down from 5 to 4
--- Developer comments ---
The Scrat Horde was balanced a lot around Ratbo’s Showoff perk before the rework to More Dakka!
It was one of many reasons we wanted to change him, and now that it’s been done, we’re willing to experiment with a cheaper Scrat Horde, hopefully making it more viable for all Masters in the game.
Ultimately the card was intended as a one button swarm, which would handle things like the Cleaver and bigger units very well, but the high mana cost and vulnerability to shock rock made it weak, but like the Soul Stealer, a lower mana cost will make the card easier to gain value from.
Stun Lancers - Health up from 70 to 120
--- Developer comments ---
Stun Lancers is a severely underused card at higher levels of play, and we believe it’s in part due to their highly specialized nature. 4 Mana for a card that stuns an enemy was a counter to the Cleaver, but not good in a lot of other situations.
Giving them a lot more health will give them a role besides stunning, as they can now form a decent frontline, and even have a chance to get to the enemy Master.


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

The Soul Stealer hasn’t seen much play because it’s a rather niche card. It’s not particularly good at countering anything for a defense, rather it “counters” swarm decks by using their strength to create a strong push of its own.
However, due to his low health, he was easily removed even when he got the stacks needed to pose a threat to the enemy Master.
With this change, he should be easier to get value out of, meaning he can be played in more situations, and has a greater reason to be included in a deck.


Scrat Horde - Mana cost down from 5 to 4
--- Developer comments ---
The Scrat Horde was balanced a lot around Ratbo’s Showoff perk before the rework to More Dakka!
It was one of many reasons we wanted to change him, and now that it’s been done, we’re willing to experiment with a cheaper Scrat Horde, hopefully making it more viable for all Masters in the game.
Ultimately the card was intended as a one button swarm, which would handle things like the Cleaver and bigger units very well, but the high mana cost and vulnerability to shock rock made it weak, but like the Soul Stealer, a lower mana cost will make the card easier to gain value from.
Stun Lancers - Health up from 70 to 120
--- Developer comments ---
Stun Lancers is a severely underused card at higher levels of play, and we believe it’s in part due to their highly specialized nature. 4 Mana for a card that stuns an enemy was a counter to the Cleaver, but not good in a lot of other situations.
Giving them a lot more health will give them a role besides stunning, as they can now form a decent frontline, and even have a chance to get to the enemy Master.


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 28 - Answer the Call
notes.notes:
To arms!

The Tri-Team Tourney is running hot, and after seeing Team Brawny take an early lead, we’re wondering where the love for Brainy and Bloody is ;)

Today’s patch changes one of the highly controversial cards of the game; Call to Arms.
Call to Arms has had a large effect on the meta of the game for quite a while, but we haven’t really been happy about the fun gained from playing against it. Thus, we’ve reworked it a bit, and in the process, balanced a few things that were held back by its presence.

Balance

Call to Arms - Reworked to:
	Mana: 3
	Replaces all your buildings with Warriors.

	Note: This means the card now destroys all buildings and spawns Warriors in their places. It no longer counts the Master Tower, and there’s a slight delay between the casting and each building being replaced. If the building dies within the delay, no Warrior is spawned.
--- Developer comments ---
Call to Arms was a card intended to use buildings for an offense. However, with the best version of a Call to Arms deck being wall and turret based, it quickly turned into a game of stalling. While we’re not against playing a defensive strategy, this version lent itself to a decidedly non-interactive way of playing, which didn’t really suit our vision of a Minion Masters match.
	A lot of players have been giving us feedback that it was unfun or boring to play against, even when they would win, and we feel a large part of this was the strategy of stalling to mana frenzy and then snowballing.
	The new version puts the onus on the player of the buildings to gain value from them as they convert to Warriors, and -  combined with the changes to the Wall and Laser Turret - should enable more interesting decision-making both for the player of Call to Arms and their opponent.
We’re looking forward to seeing what you make of it :)

Wall - Duration decreased from 45 sec to 30 sec. Health increased from 1000 to 1500
--- Developer comments ---
The Wall seems an integral part of any stalling strategy, and as mentioned above we’d like to keep stalling to a minimum while allowing defensive playstyles. We don’t believe Call to Arms was the sole component that allowed the stalling decks to work, in fact we found it rather likely that you could make the same types of decks without Call to Arms, it just wouldn’t synergize as well.
The Wall change aims to make playing the Wall a more interesting choice. It allows you to defend one large attack, but then expires. This will hopefully lead to more openings in defensive strategies, giving attackers a chance to use timings to break through.

Laser Turret - Duration decreased from 40 to 30 sec.
--- Developer comments ---
For the same reasons that the Wall was changed, so did we change the Laser turret. The turret was buffed recently to handle bigger units better, and we’re still seeing the effects of that. One of the things it also does very well however, is board control. The large range and high damage allows it to hold the line very effectively, and for a long time. This duration reduction should again make it more important to play the defensive building at the right time, as it is less likely to last you multiple attacks.

Mordar - Tombstone card Mana cost reduced from 1 to 0
--- Developer comments ---
Mordar hasn’t been performing as well as we’d hoped, in part because of a basic attack that’s hard to supplement with a deck, and in part because his perks are hard to get value out of.
Making the Tombstones cost 0 mana will allow him to gain value from resurrecting even small units, and a much larger gain from mid-cost units, while not changing the dynamics of resurrecting the very big units much.


Misc.

Tweaked Trick swap to avoid Minions at the top and bottom edges not being swapped - Thanks Rea
Tweaked the in-game shop to have smaller icons and more items per page.
The currencies in the bottom bar now follow the general flow of Gold - Shards - Rubies, as everywhere else
The error about being disconnected because of no activity in the game has been clarified.
Menu arrows now animate when clicked
Mordar has received a visual update to his model, along with some new animations.


Stormbringer has received a visual update to his model and a new portrait.


Fixed an issue where the in-game shop would display $ instead of € for people using € in Steam
Fixed an issue where the Premium upgrade bonus gold would say +200% when it should say +100% - Thanks markljunggren
Fixed an issue where using /copydeck with Milloween selected in draft would display her as ArcaneMage in chat.
Fixed an issue with certain rarities not being translated in Spanish
Fixed an issue with the Guardian doing his attack animation and then freezing in previews


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 24 - The portal closes!
notes.notes:
Hello Masters!

As the portal closes, it’s no longer possible to gather portal keys and get free versions of the new Master and Cards. Fear not, however, for it’s possible to craft and buy them as any other content would be.
In addition to that, we’ve got a new card and an exciting Master rework for this update :)

NEW Card

Drone Buzzers - these two flying drones are fast and fragile, but can provide great air support at range!


Portal event content now available for all

The portal event has ended, and Milloween and the two new spells are now available for purchase and crafting to everyone
Milloween - This Master hails from a proud magic tradition and wields immense power, though she isn’t always in full control. Focused on Spells, she uses them to empower her attack and the Arcane Golem which follows her everywhere she goes.
Hypnotize - A Legendary Spell which converts all enemy Minions caught in the area for a few seconds.
Spirit Infusion - A Rare Spell that empowers random friendly Minions with additional health


Balance

Ratbo’s Second perk - Showoff - reworked to ability More Dakka!
More Dakka! is a card that shoots the nearest enemy for damage based on the number of Minions Ratbo has on the field. 
--Designer comments--
Ratbo has long been a bit of an issue for us. He was very easy to play, extremely easy to create winning strategies with, and rather frustrating to play against. However, at the same time he was performing rather poorly at higher levels of play.
While we’d like to keep him simple and true to his aggressive nature, we also wanted to introduce something that added some depth to him, and made him more fun as an opponent as well.
More Dakka! gives him a tool that can be very powerful in the right hands, but requires timing and knowledge to get the full value out of. It still provides Ratbo with a global presence, but makes it more fun (hopefully) as an event rather than constant pressure.
We’re excited to see how the community uses this ability, and will be closely monitoring Ratbo feedback going forwards.

Laser turret - Attack Speed from 1.2 to 1.4, Damage from 20 to 40
--Designer comments--
This change aims to make the Laser Turret even better at handling extremely big units, such as the Red Golem or Troubadour. The turret should feel much the same against many units, but the maximum potential it can reach is now higher, making it more effective against units with more than 1000 health.

Red golem health mechanic reworked - It now has 800 health by default, but doubled health if its Master is below 50% health.
--Designer comments--
The Red Golem is an interesting Minion that might have been too extreme in its usage. The new design will make it less of a dead card in your starting hand, and it will allow for more counters if it gets big. Additionally it might be easier to understand it, as it’s now built on the Blue Golem health stats. Lastly this design choice was also influenced by the upcoming 2on2 feature, which it now fits better. 

Gax egg health up from 40 to 50.
--Designer comments--
Gax is one of the least used cards in the game, and we find that a lot of the reason you don’t want to play him is because he is very easily countered in his egg state by the same things that counter other boomers, with an even greater mana loss in his case. This change aims to lessen that blow, by requiring slightly more powerful spells, and perhaps giving Daggerfall some more reason to be included in decks.

The Wizard Puff’s death ability can no longer target Masters on the field, such as Settsu.
If Settsu is hypnotized on the field, she now becomes stunned instead of converted



Misc.

The main font in the game has been changed for better readability
Added a button in the replay UI to switch which side you’re watching the replay from
Anti-cheat - We have implemented a number of anti-cheat functionalities, which aim to detect and punish cheaters.
Reduced the occurrence of certain C-SAR voice lines for accounts at higher levels.
Clarified that Draft is Online, in the initial tooltip
Quest reroll tooltip now shows on hovering over the button
It’s now possible to make your own chat channels, simply write /join *channelname* to create and join
Ratbo’s model and textures have been updated, bringing you hi-def pecs in true triple indie quality.
Added an Average Mana Cost display to the deckbuilder.
Clicking a Streamer in the chat now gives you the option to open his/her Stream in a browser
Tweaked matchmaking for early searches, allowing for slightly more time to look for closer opponents before expanding.


Fixes

Fixed a number of cases of characters sliding during idle animations
Fixed an issue where the Past Leaderboards would not switch properly when clicking arrows
Fixed an issue with Disruptor Puffs clipping with the floor due to their idle animation
Cleaned up metadata for chat messages
Lethal prediction now takes Shields into account
Fixed an issue with Hypnotize highlighting buildings
Fixed an issue with Ratbo’s ragdoll spawning blood weirdly
Fixed an issue with shift-tabbing adding a space to the chat
Fixed a typo in the unlocking of Daily Quests which still said “challenges”
Fixed an issue where it was possible to spawn Minions inside the Master Tower.
Fixed a number of cases where escape/controller back button didn’t close menus
The settings menus inside the game no longer remember your state when closed, thus restarting from the initial menu whenever you open them again.
Fixed an error in the calculations for rematching against an opponent that caused it to quickly rematch rather than wait.


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 23 - Ping!
notes.notes:
Hello Masters!

The mysterious portal has been available for a week now, and already plenty of people have opened it.
We’ve enabled a timer showing when the event ends, so hurry up before the portal closes next week!

This week we’re bringing you a bunch of fixes, mostly focused on improving latency issues and disconnections, but as always, we fixed a number of bugs along the way :)

Please remember to give our new community members a warm welcome, and guidance on how best to become Grand Master in the game!

By the way, we’ve now started work on a very requested feature, stay tuned for more exciting news.

Misc.

Matchmaking now takes more matches into account, thus waiting longer before you match against opponents that you have played against within the last 5 matches.
Optimized and improved network solution for connections with high latency and/or package loss. The game should both run smoother, but also feel much better when there are small hiccups.
Removed words on loading tip pictures for the sake of localization.
Polished the transition between the Portal claim and reward screen.
Localized keyboard shortcuts in-game
Reduced the cloud cover of the tutorial levels
You can now link a Master to a specific deck. Simply click the button to the left of your deck to link your current Master to that deck. When you switch to that deck, the Master will also be selected, if available.
Enabled a timer showing when the Portal Event ends
Watch & Win tooltip now says Portal Key instead of Steam Key, for the duration of the event


Fixes

Fixed an issue with the Achievement GUI line being on top of Quests when you came back to main menu after a match
Fixed an issue with hover colours in chat not working in certain situations
Fixed an issue where the deckbuilding tooltip got stuck when you put another card than Sniper Scrat into your first deck
Fixed an issue where shift-tabbing with nothing in the chat would create an invisible tab in the message
Fixed a number of issues with controllers not working properly in game and in menus
Fixed an issue where ticking the “Include uncraftable cards” in crafting menu would show the box on top of the text if the text was too long.
Fixed an issue with the Portal event gui showing the claimed keys in the constellation slightly off-center
Fixed an issue with claiming multiple quests at the same time causing the wrong amount of gold to be shown - Thanks NekuSoul
Fixed an issue where you could get the Watch & Win event in a Queue Master battle - Thanks haLLu
Fixed an issue with Trick swap wrongly describing the stun as 0.5 sec long, rather than the correct 4 sec.
Settsu’s Blast Entry now correctly says 300 health shield, instead of 100 health shield.
Fixed an issue with chat copy message copying more data than it should-
Fixed a number of disconnect issues during loading on slower computers
Fixed an issue with the Queue Master battle not ending properly - Thanks 3FFA
Fixed an issue with being able to play unowned Masters in friend battles
Fixed an issue with the Spirit Infusion breaking when two players played it at the same time.
Fixed an issue with the wrong Master saying level up or not enough mana dialogue.
Fixed an issue with people getting “Already logged in” when they should be logged out


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 22 - A Mysterious Portal!
notes.notes:
Greetings all Minion Masters!

The mysterious portal can now be opened!

Watch Streamers on Twitch.tv as they complete Watch & Win events to get portal keys. 

Each key can be redeemed in-game for a small reward. Collect all 25 unique keys to open the portal and uncover its mysteries!

Click the event icon in the main menu to redeem keys and check your progress.

We have translated the game into several languages: 
French
Italian 
German 
Spanish
Russian 
Simplified Chinese
Portuguese-Brazil

Balance changes

Crossbow dudes - Count down from 3 to 2.
Last Stand - Legionnaires summoned when opponent has both bridges down from 8 to 7
Spear Throwers - Health up from 80 to 100
Magma Storm - Radius of each rock up from 3 to 3.5


Misc.

Season Reset. New Season started.
Introduced more Voice lines for C-SAR - Rarities, currencies, Level up, unlocking new features, Mana Frenzy, Match level up, Legendary cards and all tutorial battles.
Removed the startup screen so the game now proceeds directly to the menu. The information about the beta can be seen in the ? menu button in the upper left corner.
Implemented proper Elite Swarmer ragdoll
There is now a search bar in the deckbuilding menu
Introduced a Success message after Twitch authentication
Number of streams is now shown on the Stream highlight in menu
setchatfontsize now changes font size in the input field as well


Fixes

Fixed an issue where Stormbringer could be a free rotation Master.
Fixed an issue where card previews would ignore volume sliders from settings.
Fixed an issue where the Claim reward button in draft would show “Battle!” for text instead - thanks Beancake12
Fixed an issue where Volco’s third perk could make some units invisible or remove Rage - thanks PakoMANIAC and more
Fixed an issue where Minions with stealth gaining health would be revealed
Fixed an issue where placeholder Master text would be displayed when you went into Master selection the first time
Fixed an issue where inspecting cards during drafting phase would move the camera wrongly.
Fixed an issue where any Card rewards would be sorted wrongly when displaying rewards - Thanks markljunggren’s guide to draft
Fixed an issue where having no free tokens left would display that you had no Power Tokens.
Fixed an issue where the assassin’s health bar would disappear after having been in a Black hole - Thanks Khazlariko
Fixed an issue where you could use the same Master to complete the Win with 3 different Masters Quest - thanks Devexia
Fixed an issue where Stone League reward wouldn’t give the correct currency - thanks Katsunaka
Fixed an issue where AI would predict a target dead and switch targets, but if the target was healed by a Priestess it survived. Death prediction now takes predictable healing into account - e.g. priestess but not Healing Fireball
Fixed an issue where the Master shop tab would be missing a / in the strings


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 20 - Metal and magic
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

This week we’re bringing a couple of new cards, some balance and a bunch of fixes to the game.
Since it seems everyone loves Crossbow Dudes so much, we wanted to to give you another way to play them, but this time with a new mechanic ;)

New Card

Shielded Crossbow Dudes - This time there’s 4, so maybe it’s a gang. In any case, they’ve got magic to back them up. Each one spawns with a Shield that absorbs the first hit it takes.


New Card

Elite Swarmer - A classic from the other FORCED games, this monster has armor plating making it very hardy.



Balance Changes

Battle Shi hou - No longer counts buildings for its buff. This means it has a new state where it has 0 buffs. Stats in preview changed to reflect this. The first enemy now also counts for the buff, which means his stats are the same as before when fighting the same number of enemies, provided they are not buildings.
Dragon Nest - Health down from 250 to 150. Duration down from 25 to 20.
Colossus - Health down from 1200 to 1000. Reasoning - long
Ravagers second ability - Enrage - is now known as Feeding Frenzy


Misc.

Tweaked Swarmers attack animation to not have a full stop at the start
Fixed an issue where the Priestess could cause the game to crash
Fixed an issue where Volco’s basic attack VFX would point in the wrong direction
You can no longer claim Achievement rewards while searching for a match
Fixed an issue where resuming a Queue Master battle counted as watching a replay.
Introduced a confirmation message when you authenticate your Twitch account for streaming
Tweaked a large number of SFX volumes
A language dropdown is now available in General Settings. But we don’t have any other languages yet.
Fixed an issue where the bottom menu would appear when returning from rewards in a victory screen
You can no longer drag cards in Deck Building with right-click
Fixed an issue where the Crafter Achievements would trigger on salvage - Thanks haLLu
Fixed an issue where using the Get some! Button when buying a draft ticket would make the draft menu break
Fixed an issue where units could be pushed behind the Master Tower if spawned inside it - Thanks Nobody
The Redeem code field is now cleared when you claim a reward
Fixed a number of issues where tooltips would appear in a location based on your mouse cursor, rather than the element you inspected - Thanks 3FFA
Fixed an issue where Settsu wouldn’t reload when flying back to her Master Tower - Thanks Khazlariko
Something mysterious is coming
Fixed an issue where Masters would be in the wrong animation state after drafting.
Fixed an issue where Minions who did something on death would affect their resurrected versions if resurrected by a Mordar Tombstone.
Added a Twitch icon in Global Chat to players who are Streaming
Fixed a number of occurrences of text being cut off at the bottom
Main menu labels are now shown by default


Cheers from BetaDwarf!
