notes.title: Update 19 - Achievement unlocked!
notes.notes:
Dear Minions,

This week we’re bringing your Masters something special. They now have the opportunity to earn achievements in the show by doing extremely specific tasks. So don’t think twice when your Master sacrifices you for no apparent reason, he’s probably just cycling to get that 5 spell combo achievement :D

Achievements
An achievements tab has opened in the profile menu. Completing achievements earns you rubies or shards or even high rarity cards. They will also award a corresponding Steam Achievement for the game.

Balance Changes

In periods of high activity, the Draft matchmaking now waits longer before expanding the search for opponents. This favors pairing higher win players with other higher win players during high activity periods.
Crossbow dudes attack delay up from .1 sec to .25 sec. This was done for a visual fix - to avoid the snapping animation - but it does have a minuscule effect on balance.
Future Present and Future Past can no longer draw each other (in addition to already not being able to draw themselves)
Stealth units no longer stealth while stunned. They are also revealed if stunned.
Chain lightning now hits stealthed enemies.
Players now have 2 deck options from level 1.


Misc.

Fixed an issue where the Victory screen would display the wrong match time for Premium users.
Introduced a Featured Offers screen to the store
Fixed an issue with the unit preview stats showing .1 decimals because of a floating point error
Draft Master now doesn’t revert until after the rewards have been claimed
Introduced a GL HF emoji
Fixed an issue where the Fire Imp would split its damage on the ground up over 5 seconds instead of 4 seconds. 
Balance note: The long term dps was the same, but the tick rate would be 1.25 instead of 1, and double tick when the second hit landed. This fixes it to be a constant stream of damage in 1 sec ticks.
Fixed the fact that Crossbow Dudes snapped in their attack animation and gave them a reload animation
Fixed Laser turret going completely silent.
Fixed an issue where restarting the game while having 12 wins in draft would show the wrong win icon upon restart. - Thanks Vanghern
Fixed an issue where aiming units such as Styxi would still shoot a target after it had been converted from enemy to friendly.
Fixed an issue where Level 68 rewards would display as Level 58. - Thanks Khazlariko
Fixed an issue where using /deck in chat when in draft menu displayed your ranked deck rather than draft deck.
Last Stands spawn sound effect tweaked
Fixed an issue where Gax wasn’t highlighted by spells. - You’re welcome 3FFA
Fixed an issue where users could use developer commands - Thanks Mr Visser
Fixed an issue where converting Disruptor Puffs with a ghost would permanently increase the cost of your card slot
Fixed an issue where Undying Skeleton would still respawn if killed by a Wizard Puffs curse
Fixed an issue where Spear Throwers would counts as melee and ranged in the wrong cases. They should now properly count as ranged until they throw their spear, then count as melee.
Fixed an issue where getting a new card and then drafting that card in Draft mode would display NEW on that card in your draft deck.
Fixed an issue where sounds were missing on the Season Reset screen.
Made a greater distinction between the symbols for Platinum and Diamond to avoid confusion
Fixed an issue where the bottom menu bar would appear when you were claiming rewards
Fixed an issue where you could salvage cards while the server was shutting down.
Implemented visually distinct chests for the different types of rewards - Common, Rare, Supreme, Legendary
Reworked some draft win icons to more clearly indicate how awesome 12 wins was
Disruptor Puffs are now closer to the ground in their preview
Moved the redeem code button to the upper right corner of the shop
Reworked emote menu to be clearer


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 18 - Fire away!
notes.notes:
Minion Masters!

Today is a smaller patch than usual content wise, because we’ve been focused on improving a number of our existing systems for performance and structure. This won’t show much until we get further in development, but it sets us up for future updates to take effect :)

New Card

Fire Imp - This little pyromaniac throws fire at ground enemies, dealing a lot of damage over time.


Balance Changes

The Draft matchmaking now waits longer before expanding the search for opponents. This favors pairing higher win players with other higher win players.


Misc.

Fixed an issue where your Master would float above the pedestal in solo challenges
Prepared a number of systems for the upcoming Season Reset at the end of February
Polished the plate that Masters stand on
Fixed an issue where the UI would show you as lowest among Grand Masters in a new season, despite being highest - Thanks Memfisto
Fixed an issue where Premium Upgrade bonuses weren’t displayed for Draft matches
Fixed an issue where going into Solo Challenges before you selected a Master in Draft would hide away skill info when you returned to the draft
The Leaderboard no longer shows Draft decks, only ranked decks.
Updated Crossbow Guild’s tooltip to properly show the production speed of 4.8 sec. No balance change.
Fixed an issue where Troubadour would not be highlighted by spells - Thanks 3FFA
Fixed fog in forward rendering mode not applying to the standard shader.
Fixed an issue where quitting before the match properly started would create a replay that displayed the wrong result.
Fixed an issue where Illusory Cleaver could cause infinite loops upon death.
Fixed a number of issues where Xiao Long would Spell Burn when he shouldn’t - Black Hole, Stun and Ghost Conversion.
New Season Ranks are now based on your Best Rank in the previous season, rather than the rank you ended at.
Ghost now properly interrupts itself when its target is converted.
Fixed an issue where the game would display getting rewards from new Leagues multiple times, despite the user not actually getting them.
Tweaked the Building placement system feedback to be much clearer and display exactly where you can place new buildings in relation to already placed ones. This has had a slight effect on the actual radius of the buildings.
A small hint for a new Master coming is now visible in Master selection
Fixed an issue with Watch & Win not ending correctly
Reduced the performance load of the Main Menu GUI system


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

The first Draft is free, subsequent runs can be bought for 1500 gold or 120 rubies and will reward you for every victory. See how many wins you can reach before you’ve lost three times.

notes.title: Update 14 - Wild Cards!
notes.notes:
Dear Minion Masters!

Today we bring you a completely new feature - Wild Cards!
We have always wanted to find a way to allow extra deckbuilding depth and possibilities to include additional copies of a specific card. We know several community members have requested a feature for doing so as well. Who doesn’t want to try two priestesses in one deck? Now you can try with three!
After experimenting with a lot of different approaches we’ve finally found a solution we are more than satisfied with - Wild Cards!
With Wild Cards you can include up to three of the same card in your deck (if you have that many!). This means that among the 10 cards in your deck, you can have 3 of the same one, or two cards of which you have two copies each.
We have played a ton with it on the office and we’ve had a lot of fun with extra creativity and depth. So starting today, we are looking forward to how you will use your two Wild Cards! :)

New Cards

Chain Lightning - Lightning that jumps from target to target dealing 100 damage.
Spear Throwers - Militia who has trained with a Spear, but throws it away at enemies.


Anti-cheat
We’ve been brewing up this feature for a while, but it turned out to be a lot more complex than we had hoped.
Anti-cheat will allow our servers to identify attempts at cheating and handle them accordingly.
We would still very much like to hear of any potential issues and try to include those in the system.

Balance Changes

Plasma Marines Health down from 60 to 50
Drone Force One Health up from 200 to 220


Misc.

New cards will no longer be salvaged automatically. We have added a Salvage Surplus feature in the crafting section, to salvage all spare cards.
Fixed sad and angry emotes.
Added a feature to show a featured stream
Added anti-spam feature to chat (no need to test it)
Tweaked chat colors of /msgdeck
You can now mute opponent emotes
Fixed a bug with Dragon Nest not spawning correctly
Changed the wording when losing points in Grandmaster
Fixed an issue caused by casting minions in the middle gap of the arena
Optimized loading of Loading Tips
Fixed an issue of being stuck in the loading screen after a match. 
Succubus will now correctly blink back if hit.
Corrected wrong numbers in Volco’s descriptions.
Fixed an issue showing wrong replay duration
Blastmancer and Spiritmancer now correctly loses focus if their target is in a Black Hole
Fixed an issue where Shock Rock would block buffs and healing
Graphics settings below "The Good" will turn ragdolls off


Cheers from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update 11 - Spirit of the holidays
notes.notes:
Hello Friends!,

Today we’ve got a small update for you to enhance your holiday experience.

notes.title: Update 10 - Friendly Battles
notes.notes:
Hello Friends!

Get ready for an amazing Minion Masters holiday!
Introducing the first event in Minion Masters: Frisky Friend Fiesta!

You’ve all been craving friend battles, so we wanted to make something special out of it in the holidays.
Get your friends into the game and play against them to earn extra rewards during the Christmas holiday, with the all new Friend Battles feature!

Friend Battles
You can now challenge your Steam friends to a duel from inside Minion Masters.

Frisky Friend Fiesta Event
We’ve added a new daily quest, that can be completed by dueling a friend. The next three weeks you will get this quest every day in addition to the regular daily quests! 

Apep
A new Master, Apep the Serpent God, has entered the fray. With the ability to gain free cards and make himself invulnerable, he is bound to make an impact! 

Rare Spin
Spin four times and the next spin will be an Rare Spin. A spin that only consists of rewards that are rare or above! Guaranteed!

NEW Minions

Walking Blind Date
Wall


Balance changes


Defenso Chopper

	Return damage decreased from 100 to 80
Return stun length increased from 1 to 3 sec.

Blastmancer

	Attack speed decreased from 0.3 to 0.8
        Damage increased from 1 to 5

Bannerman

	Inspire buff - Damage bonus decreased from 30 to 25


Shock Rock - Stun Duration increased from 1 to 2 sec.
Wizard Puff - Reworked. If it dies, it will transform a random enemy unit into a friendly Mana puff
Ghost - Reworked. The Ghost now puts Curse on the target it possesses. Curse: Deals 4% of its max health as damage per sec.


Misc.

Added support for special characters in name
Changed Rampage effect and card art 
Reduced the chance of meeting the same opponent in a row
The small card that shows the next card will also show if the mana cost has been changed
Added missing icon to Gax information
Tweaked Future Past description to better reflect what it does
Added some missing sound effects
Added hide chat function
Tweaked King Puff invulnerable effect
Fixed an issue where users was locked from purchasing
Fixed an issue with Minions’ walk animations breaking after being rooted by a Snake Druid
The quest “Reach Mana frenzy” has been reworked to “Reach level 3”
Fixed some issues where menus would remember which state you were in. They should all open to the default menu when closed and opened again
Fixed an issue where you could stack up more than 3 quests
Improved chat UI - darker background, clearer maximize button
Fixed an issue where the Infiltration Spell was not affected by Volume Settings
Polished some shop buy sounds
Fixed some issues with Black Hole showing rim-lighting on buildings and not showing rim-lighting on friendly Minions
Fixed an issue where Drone Force One’s next attack animation would look weird if it was stunned during an attack
Fixed an issue where Brutus’ next attack animation would be slowed down if his target died during an attack
Fixed an issue with some particle effects being on top of UI in the menu


Happy Holidays from BetaDwarf!

notes.title: Update v0.4.0 - Patch Notes & Servers are open!
notes.notes:
Greatings Masters, we have a brand new update for you and the Servers are now open!

As always, thank you so much for taking your time to help us out with all your wonderful feedback.
Here's a list of the balance changes and the most important bug fixes we've done since last test.

Balance changes

Beam of Doom changes

	[Nerf] Mana Cost 5 -> 6
	[Nerf] Damage from 500 -> 400
	[Buff] Damage to minions is doubled

Crossbow Guild Changes

[Nerf] Mana cost 5 -> 6
[Nerf] Production 1 -> 2
[Buff] Production Time 7 sec -> 4.8 sec

[Nerf] Swarmer Totem spawn time 6.2 sec -> 7 sec
[Nerf][WellBugFixReally] Call To Arms is now a defensive spell.


*It's a known bug that the card info has not been updated to reflect the new production times


Improvements

Graphics settings
Low health warning state on towers - Lights and smoke and stuff
The lost card - Fixed an issue that made Dagger Fall disappear
Improved melee units pathfinding towards their target when crossing bridges
Fixed rare issue where AI stops playing cards
Unit Healthbars drawn on top of timer
Fixed a bug that would fail to play a card and then leave the card slot empty
Various fixes with completing quests and gaining new quests



And an additional 67 bug fixes and minor improvements to dailies, server stability and lots of other stuff.

notes.title: Update v0.3.25 - Patch Notes & Servers are open!
notes.notes:
Dear beloved Minion Masters, we have updates for you and the Servers are now open!

Thanks for all your wonderful feedback during the last test days! We have made a ton of fixes, but here's a few of the most noticeable.

Balance changes 

    Increased Shard gains when Scrapping cards.
    Daily challenge rewards has been increased significantly.


We have noted down a ton of your balance change suggestions, but we'd like to collect a bit more data before we make changes. 
A good example of a card that feels very strong is the Crossbow Guild, however its win rate is very close to 50%, so we'd like to think a bit about why it's perceived as imbalanced. 


Improvements 

    New and improved Cleaver model.
    New Cleaver card art.
    New Cleaver VFX.
A ton of Audio fixes and improvements.
A main menu Puff?
Fixed reward text, now only one.
Improved Arena effects.
Various minor fixes in the Power Tower.
Rarity sounds.
Improved Daily Challenges UI.
More cheat security.
Styxi animations improved.
Chat stability fixes.
Master healthbars re-arranged.
Illusory Cleaver card art update.
Ravager abilities art.
Stun blast card art.
Sniper Scrat card art.



And an additional 122 bug fixes and minor improvements to dailies, server stability and lots of other stuff.

Cheers!

Also  @baboonlord just started streaming,  come say hello
